globalNews.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
globalNews.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

globalNews.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
globalNews.summary: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

globalNews.title: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row
globalNews.summary: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US.

globalNews.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
globalNews.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

globalNews.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
globalNews.summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

cryptoNews.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
cryptoNews.summary: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

cryptoNews.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
cryptoNews.summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

cryptoNews.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
cryptoNews.summary: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

cryptoNews.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
cryptoNews.summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

aiNews.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
aiNews.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

aiNews.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
aiNews.summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

aiNews.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
aiNews.summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

aiNews.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
aiNews.summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.

aiNews.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
aiNews.summary: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.
